title: Weekly sync — Serving/Infra/Console — Agenda + prep (personal scratchpad)
body:
Context: prep notes for weekly cross-team sync (serving runtime + infra + console). Mostly personal scratchpad — use to steer conversation, capture decisions, and track follow-ups. Keep this file as ephemeral; will move action items to Linear after meeting.

Duration: 45 minutes (tight)
Attendees (expected): Evan (me), Sofia (runtime), Raj (infra), Maya (console), optional: Lina (SRE)

Goal: 1) triage bursty latency regression seen last week; 2) decide canary rollout plan for model-variant switch; 3) quick console follow-ups (cost dashboards + tracing hooks).

Agenda (proposed):
- 0–5m: Quick round / blockers (everyone) — call out any unexpected outages or customer escalations.
- 5–20m: Batcher latency regression triage (Sofia lead)
  - Summary: 10–90p50 latency increase for small requests after recent batching change (PR #789).
  - Key data points to have ready: 95/99 latencies, SLO-slice by route, traffic % affected, a sample trace.
  - Hypotheses: a) batching window increase + low-concurrency traffic means longer wait; b) kernel-selection path changed for short sequences; c) autoscaler slower to add slots for sudden bursts.
  - Quick asks for the meeting: Sofia to present timeline and perf graphs; Raj to confirm any infra-side scaling anomalies; Maya to show console view (token-level and route-level).
  - Desired outcome: agree on a short mitigation path (toggle batching param roll-back or set smarter dynamic window) and owner for revert if needed.

- 20–30m: Canary rollout for model-variant X (Raj lead)
  - Context: rolling out quantized variant X.q32 to reduce per-token cost for hosted customers. We want canary at 1% -> 5% -> 20% if no regressions.
  - Risk surface: output-quality regressions, increased tail latency for some sequences, cache incompatibility (KV cache format).
  - Questions to answer in sync: what metrics will gate progression? (latency p95, rerate on eval prompts, customer QA sign-off).
  - Decision: pick canary metrics and owners; set automatic rollback threshold in rollout policy.
  - Prep action: Sofia to run daily eval suite on X.q32 and post results; Maya to add a canary dashboard tile (compare baseline vs canary).

- 30–38m: Console follow-ups (Maya lead)
  - Cost dashboard: show token-level cost breakouts for last 7 days (spike on Dec 16). Need root cause: was this due to model choice or anomaly in routing?
  - Tracing hooks: request-level tracing is missing for a subset of internal routes (observability gap). Proposal: add trace sampling for internal traffic 0.5% to surface any KV-cache misses.
  - Action: Maya to open a small RFC for tracing change; Lina to validate retention/cost implications.

- 38–45m: Action-item review + parking lot
  - Quick go/no-go for batching rollback.
  - Confirm owners, deadlines; move items to Linear.

Prep notes / live pointers (things to mention or check during meeting):
- Bring up customer report from Acme Corp — they saw a 3x p95 on Dec 16 around 10:37 PST; ticket REDWOOD-ACME-114 (linked in Slack).
- Have the following dashboards open:
  - Runtime perf: /dashboards/runtime/latency-by-route (filter: last 7d)
  - Autoscaler events: /dashboards/infra/autoscaler-events (filter: last 48h)
  - Console cost: /dashboards/console/token-costs (last 14d)
- Quick logs/trace snippets to paste in chat if needed: sample trace IDs (placeholder): trace/abc123, trace/def456.

Action items (scratchpad — will assign in Linear after meeting):
- [Sofia] short-term mitigation: rollback batching-window change on canary nodes and monitor p50/p95 within 2 hours. Due: EOD today (owner: Sofia).
- [Raj] infra check: confirm autoscaler logs for Dec 16 spike + any throttling events; report back with timeline. Due: tomorrow noon.
- [Maya] add a canary comparison tile to console — baseline vs X.q32 (latency, token cost, error-rate). Due: 48h.
- [Evan] collate customer-facing timeline for Acme incident and draft a one-pager for CS. Due: tomorrow EOD.
- [Lina/SRE] sanity-check tracing sampling RFC for retention/cost impact. Due: next sync.

Unresolved/parking-lot items (keep short):
- Longer-term: update the autoscaler to consider request-rate-of-small-payloads vs token-throughput (next quarter).
- Investigate whether kernel-selection heuristics need a separate experiment flag (low priority).

Notes-to-self (personal):
- If we rollback, prepare communication plan: short Slack + timestamped note in status page + update customers on impacted routes.
- Remind product about migration windows for Dedicated customers if we change default model variants.

Meeting follow-up workflow (how I will process this):
1) During meeting: add new action items inline in this doc, mark owner and rough due date.
2) Immediately after meeting: convert items to Linear tasks, tag with team and sprint, link back to this doc.
3) 24h check-in: quick thread update for items in flight.

Quick draft Slack post for sync summary (to send after meeting):
"TL;DR: Agreed short rollback of batching-window on canary to mitigate p95 regression; infra to validate autoscaler events; canary rollout plan for X.q32 approved with gating metrics (SLO + eval checks). Action owners: Sofia (rollback), Raj (autoscaler), Maya (canary dashboard), Evan (customer timeline). I'll create Linear tasks and follow up."

-- end scratchpad --
